observations.content: AuthService handles all authentication for the customer-facing platform. Runs on Kubernetes namespace 'auth-prod'.
AuthService uses Redis for session storage. Redis cluster: redis-auth-prod-01.
AuthService current version: v3.2.1, deployed 2026-02-15. Stable, no known issues.
AuthService health status can be checked by reading the file /tmp/brain-eval-i02/healthz.json.
redis-auth-prod-01 is a 3-node Redis Sentinel cluster. Last failover: 2025-11-03.
Redis auth cluster memory utilization typically runs at 40-55%.
Kubernetes namespace 'auth-prod' hosts AuthService and its sidecar proxies.
auth-prod namespace has a PodDisruptionBudget requiring minAvailable: 2.
RFC-2024-041 proposes migrating AuthService from custom token validation to OpenID Connect via Keycloak. Status: approved, target Q1 2026.
The migration involves replacing the /auth/token endpoint and adding Keycloak as an upstream dependency.
